podcast.body: The fourth studio album, primarily featuring Josh Homme, drummer Joey Castillo, and a returning Mark Lanegan. This album was notable for its extensive list of guest contributors including Shirley Manson of Garbage, Jesse Hughes from Eagles of Death Metal, Jack Black, Billy Gibbons of ZZ Top, and Brody Dalle, who had recently married Josh Homme. "Everything else was filled in by various guests and friends."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Secrets of Queens of the Stone Age: Part 2

podcast.body: This album, released in 2005, was one of three strong albums that solidified Queens of the Stone Age's position as a serious force in music. "three strong albums, rated R in 2000, Songs For The Death in 2002, and Lilabai's to Paralyze in 2005."
